name: terminal-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-terminal — the Terminal row inside the workspace nav popover (new terminal, running-terminal flyout, close), extracted from aw-app-code-agent-clis' Agents menu and registered into the core.nav.workspace slot. src/client.js is the framework-free client for core's own /api/terminals endpoints; src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
